decisions.topic: 重要事項変更時の再説明・同意
national_source_findings: Current Article 8 / Article 105 clearly require explanation and consent before service starts.
MHLW document-burden materials depict important-matters documents at change points, but do not establish a binding rule that every post-contract change requires renewed written consent.
decisions.boundary: Do not extrapolate pre-start consent requirements to every later change.

decisions.topic: 機能訓練指導員の提供日・単位ごとの配置
national_source_findings: Article 93 defines staffing as employees to be placed at each designated day-service establishment.
Functional-training instructor is stated simply as one or more.

The same article explicitly states per-service-day requirements for life counselors and per-unit requirements for nurses/care workers, but does not use those qualifiers for functional-training instructors.
decisions.boundary: This is the basic staffing standard only. Add-on-specific exclusive staffing/time requirements are separate.

decisions.topic: サービス提供時間中の理美容
national_source_findings: MHLW Q&A states hairdressing/beauty service need not be limited to before or after day service when clearly separated from the insured service.
The 2018 combined insured/non-insured service notice also permits clearly separated hairdressing/beauty service during a temporary interruption of day service.
decisions.boundary: MQ-002 asks whether a care worker may itself cut hair. That adds professional/licensing and provider-role questions not resolved by the timing Q&A.

decisions.topic: サービス提供時間中の訪問診療
national_source_findings: MHLW Q&A says use of a co-located medical institution during the day-service service period is generally not allowed except in urgent unavoidable cases.
Current guidance also addresses online care and off-insurance health services, but does not by itself settle every in-person visiting-physician/dentist scenario represented by MQ-003.
decisions.boundary: Do not generalize a co-located medical-institution Q&A to all forms of visiting medical/dental care.

decisions.topic: 外出レクリエーション
national_source_findings: MHLW interpretation notice states day service is generally provided inside the establishment but may be provided outside when specified conditions are met.
MHLW 2018 notice distinguishes planned functional-training outings from individual off-insurance outings.
decisions.boundary: A future Claim should separate insured planned outdoor service from personal off-insurance outings and should not infer all recreation/time arrangements from the general rule.
